card.name: mom
card.notes: Fourth roster athlete (user, 2026-11-05: MomRigged.fbx from AccuRig, "tough and stubborn", 1.68 m / 80 kg). Rigged by Scripts/rig_mixamo.py's AccuRig/CC path (A-pose arms straightened to Grandpa/Matt's rest; 92 CC shape keys dropped). Toughest neck on the roster (toughness 1.2 vs Matt 1.15) and slowest to wear down (neck damage 0.03 per m/s of snap, stamina 0.03 per strike vs Grandpa's 0.04 / 0.05); a steady hitter, not a fast one (strength 0.6 like Kim, speed 0.7 between Matt 0.55 and Grandpa 0.75), a little less supple than Kim (flexibility 0.9). Strike mass scaled to body mass as for the others (3.0 kg per 78 kg). Same rules as grandpa.json otherwise.

style.summary: Balance: square and planted - knees softly bent 15 deg, hips nearly straight over the feet (3 deg, COM +0.1 cm), hands low. Slap: a quick upward chop - a full hip and trunk turn and a lean to make up for a short reach, the lead arm kept at her side, almost no follow-through.

slap.note: (wind-up, strike, follow-through) degrees, slap_demo.py's conventions (see kim.json). Mom: quick, because every athlete drifts onto the podium ~0.75 s into stand targets and her slow joints (speed 0.7) need the time; a high arm (the face is ~30 cm above her shoulder) with a full trunk/hip turn and a lean, because her reach is short like Kim's (hand 17 cm short of the face in the best static pose vs Grandpa 4, Matt 1, Kim 16); the lead arm hangs at her side (in front it hit the podium in the wind-up); short follow-through.

sparring.note: Practice opponent: Grandpa's face from Mom's start pelvis (his own 0.74 m less the ~2 cm their pelvises differ); up to 15 cm lower for Kim; leaning in when braced
